name: Planet Technology Corporation
summary: Planet Technology Corporation engages in research, development, manufacturing, import, export, and trading of computers and peripheral equipment, internet equipment, and software. The company offers network management products; network infrastructure products, such as industrial ethernet, industrial automation, broadband communication, power over ethernet, network security, wireless LAN, LAN switches, and media conversion; and network application products, including IP telephony, network peripheral, IP surveillance, and home automation.
